# Compatibility Fixtures
`checkpoint-v2.json` contains synthetic schema-2/chunking-3 journals and exact TXT/SRT/VTT/JSON outputs produced by the pre-refactoring implementation (base `81b6703`, behavior retained by `0188baf`). The input is the literal string `deterministic input`; no recording, model or real transcript is included.

Paths are normalized to `/fixture`. Tests relocate only input/output paths and the corresponding final JSON hash, then verify fingerprints, resume an unfinished tail or a partially published result, and compare the new chunk and final outputs against these frozen bytes. Expected results must not be regenerated by the implementation under test. Changes to versions or serialized contracts require an explicit compatibility decision and fixture review.
